strings.요일별 시간 블록을 편집해 주간 시간표를 만드세요. 겹치는 시간을 확인하: Edit time blocks by day to create a weekly schedule. Check overlapping times and save as PNG·SVG·print.
strings.원래 분량을 1, 목표 분량을 원하는 배수로 입력하면 배수 조절로 쓸 수: Enter the original quantity as 1 and the target quantity as a desired multiple. You can adjust the multiple as needed. The ingredient quantity supports decimals or fractions like 1/2.
strings.원형 피자의 면적은 π × (지름 ÷ 2)²입니다. 1인치는 2.54cm: The area of a round pizza is π × (diameter ÷ 2)². 1 inches is 2.54 cm, and the exact ratio is determined by removing π. The area and displayed unit price are rounded values.
strings.월 환산 ⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧ · 향후 12개월 결제 ⟦I18N_VAR: Monthly adjustment ⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧ · payment for 12 future months ⟦I18N_VAR_1⟧
strings.월·연 구독료를 같은 기준으로 비교하세요. 월 환산액과 향후 12개월 결: Compare monthly and annual subscription fees based on the same criteria. Check the monthly adjustment amount, the sum of payments for 12 future months, and the manually entered renewal schedule.
strings.월과 시작 요일을 골라 메모가 있는 달력을 만드세요. PNG·SVG로 저: Choose a month and start day to create a calendar with notes. Save as PNG·SVG or print on A4 width.
strings.유가는 직접 입력한 값이며 실시간 가격이 아닙니다. 주행·정체·냉난방에: Fuel cost is a directly entered value and is not the real-time price. Actual fuel usage varies based on driving, idling, and heating or cooling
Enter the name in 60 characters or less.
Deleted the usage statistics settings and the analysis cookie of this tool.
strings.인물 사진의 배경을 브라우저에서 지우고 투명 PNG로 저장하세요. 첫 실: Remove the background of the person portrait photo from the browser and save as transparent PNG. The first run is for public examples; your photo is processed on the device.
strings.인분·배수에 맞춰 여러 재료량을 한 번에 조절하세요. 1/2 같은 분수를: Adjust multiple ingredient amounts according to portion and multiple. Enter fractions like 1/2 and copy or save the result with the original unit.
strings.입력 단가 ⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧원/kWh를 모든 사용량에 동일하게 적용: Input unit ⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧ won/kWh applied uniformly to all usage. It does not calculate actual KT power rates or progressive rates. It does not include base rates, taxes, or discounts.
strings.입력한 묶음 가격과 배송비를 총 내용량으로 나눕니다. 할인은 반영한 가격: Divides the entered bundle price and shipping fee by the total quantity. Enter the discounted price directly. Quality, storage, and usage are not compared.
strings.자격·계약·보험 등 법적 나이 판정에는 사용하지 마세요. 기관·지역별 기: Do not use for legal age determination such as eligibility, contract, or insurance. Check standards by institution or region separately. Birthdays are calculated only in this tab and disappear when refreshing.
Automatic copy is blocked, so I selected the content. Copy it manually.
Automatic copy is blocked, so I selected the address. Copy it manually.
Move subtitles forward or backward or correct slowly drifting sync. Check negative timing and overlap, then save as SRT or VTT.
strings.작은 사진을 브라우저에서 AI로 2배 확대하고 원본과 비교해 PNG로 저: Zoom the small image 2x with AI in the browser and save it as a PNG. A 3·4x output uses additional interpolation, and the image will not be sent outside the device.
strings.전체 연비는 총 주행거리 ÷ 총 소비 연료입니다. 구간별 연비의 단순 평: Total fuel consumption is total distance ÷ total fuel used. It differs from the simple average of segment fuel consumption.
strings.정격 전력은 실제 평균과 다를 수 있습니다. 냉장고 등 주기적으로 작동하: Rated power may differ from the actual average. For devices that operate periodically, such as refrigerators, use the measured average W and 100% or rated W and the operating ratio. Do not duplicate the savings rate in both methods.
Compare the order, limit, minimum purchase, and free shipping conditions of precision and fixed-amount coupons. Also check the input order, reverse order, and unused coupon amounts.
Up to 366 excluded dates can be entered.
strings.종일·시간 지정·반복 일정을 ICS 파일로 만드세요. 실제 발생 날짜와: Create an ICS file for the daily, time‑specified, repeating schedule. Verify the actual occurrence date and time zone, then import it directly into the calendar.
strings.좌석 격자에 빈자리·고정석을 설정하고 이름을 배치하세요. 실제 행·열의: Set empty seats and fixed seats in the seat grid, and arrange names. Save the actual row/column layout as PNG·SVG·CSV.
strings.주소·텍스트·Wi-Fi·연락처 QR 코드를 만들고 PNG·SVG로 저장하: Create a QR code for address, text, Wi-Fi, and contact info, then save as PNG or SVG. The input is processed by the browser.
strings.중간값은 반올림하지 않고 비용은 최종 원 단위 반올림합니다. 1인당 금액: The median is not rounded; costs are rounded to the nearest whole unit. The per-person amount is for reference only, and the rounded sum may differ from the total.
strings.지름·판 수·가격으로 피자 주문안을 비교하세요. 서로 다른 크기를 섞고: Compare pizza orders by diameter, number of slices, and price. Mix different sizes and account for shipping costs to determine total area and price per area.
strings.집중·짧은 휴식·긴 휴식을 설정하고 세션을 기록하세요. 일시정지·집중 화: Set focus·short break·long break and record sessions. Provides pause·focus screen and CSV save. The next phase is started directly
strings.최대 3개 오디오 파일에서 구간을 잘라 순서대로 합치고 짧은 페이드를 넣: Cut sections from up to 3 audio files, combine them in order, and add a short fade. Check the waveform and time, then save as WAV PCM 16-bit.
strings.최대 5개의 타이머를 함께 실행하세요. 1·5·10·25분 프리셋, 개별: Run up to 5 timers together. Provides preset options for 1·5·10·25 minutes, individual time stops, optional stop sounds, and recording saving.
Enter 0–200% for the additional time ratio.
strings.출처·매체·캠페인을 입력해 추적 링크를 만드세요. 기존 UTM 교체 내용: Enter source, medium, and campaign to create a tracking link. Verify the replacement UTM content and copy the completed URL
strings.쿠폰별 원 단위 처리: ⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧. 정률 할인은 적용 직전: Unit handling per coupon: ⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧. Regular discounts are calculated based on the product amount just before application.
strings.크러스트·두께·토핑·맛·쿠폰은 비교하지 않습니다. 할인은 적용 후 한 판: No comparison for border, thickness, topping, flavor, or coupons. Enter the discounted price per unit. Shipping fee is added once per order.
strings.태어난 날과 기준일로 만 나이·다음 생일·경과 일수를 확인하세요. 여러: Age from date of birth to reference date, next birthday, and elapsed days. Multiple birthdays and leap years for February 29 are calculated together.
strings.파일의 SHA-256·SHA-512를 계산하고 기대값과 비교하세요. 큰: Calculate the SHA-256·SHA-512 checksum of the file and compare with the expected value. You can split large files into smaller parts, read them, and cancel processing mid-process.
strings.페이지·문제와 완료 회독을 남은 공부 가능일에 나누세요. 날짜별 번호와: Divide the page and problem and completed page count by the remaining study days. Check the number by date and unassigned amount, then save it as CSV or calendar.
strings.평년의 2월 29일 생일: Birthday on February 29 of the common year
The display is rounded to the third decimal place and provides an exact ratio value. Irreducible items like eggs are adjusted by the cook. Cooking time, temperature, and pan size are not proportionally adjusted.
Enter the daily available time as a whole number between 1–1,440 minutes.
Please check the possible learning days.
strings.학습일과 직접 정한 복습 간격으로 날짜표를 만드세요. 쉬는 날짜를 반영하: Create a calendar using the learning date and directly set review intervals. Reflect rest days and save to CSV or ICS calendar file.
strings.한글·영문 문장으로 시간·정확도·오타를 확인하세요. 조합이 끝난 글자를: Check time, accuracy, and errors in Korean and English sentences. Measure completed characters and save results distinguishing mobile/PC keyboards.
Item changes have been reflected. Recalculate.
Enter up to 1–⟦I18N_VAR_0⟧ items for each item.
strings.행렬 덧셈·뺄셈·곱·전치·행렬식·역행렬·RREF를 계산하세요. 행 소거: Calculate matrix addition, subtraction, multiplication, transposition, determinant, inverse matrix, and RREF. Check the row elimination process and numerical tolerance.
strings.향후 12개월은 기준일부터 12개월 뒤 날짜 직전까지입니다. 다음 결제일: The next 12 months are from the reference date to the day before the 12th month. Starting from the next payment date, the original date is maintained per cycle; if it does not exist in that month, it is adjusted to the end of that month. The next month returns to the original date.
strings.현재 입력을 예시로 바꿀까요?: Should I change the current input to an example?
strings.환산 비용과 실제 기간 결제액은 다를 수 있습니다. 무료 체험·해지·가격: The converted cost and the actual payment period may differ. Free trial, cancellation, price increase, refund, and payment provider renewal rules are not reflected. Enter manually, then check the payment date and actual service schedule. Account connection, cancellation, and notifications are not provided.
